releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 12
releases.body:
Vita3K Android release 12 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- SD card support: Allow any folder to be specified as the OS/game data folder (inspired by the PR from nurunuruslime)
- Allow the overlay to be used at the same time as the touchscreen
- Fix black bands appearing sometimes at the top and bottom of the application on some devices
- Fix bug causing game installation to be 10x slower than expected
- Fix accelerometer and gyroscope on android game consoles
- Some crash fixes
- Add controller opacity (dima)



Rebase on PC version:
- Fix audio regression (bookmist)
- Code cleanup, refractoring and small optimisations (bookmist, Nishinji and GermanAizek)
- Improved error messages (croden)
- GUI improvements (Zangetsu)
- Improve depth-stencil retrieval, fix Ratchet and Clank (Macdu)
- Add support for module unloading/reloading, allows FFX to be playable (Macdu)
- Improve ffmpeg dependency (KhoraLee)
- Improve Transfer downscale/copy, fix graphical issues in Phantasy Star Nova (Macdu)
- Improve Polish localization (mavethee)

releases.name: Vita3K Android Release 11
releases.body:
Vita3K Android release 11 Changelog (non exhaustive list):
- Revert part of the shader optimisations from the last release (because of turnip driver bugs...)
- Fix some issues with the handling of MSAA 2x, fix graphical issues (partial blur) in some Nihon Falcon games
- Allow custom drivers and renderer to be set differently for each game
- Fix some crashes when installing games / custom drivers
- Use a static version of ffmpeg now that the Android version is open source

Rebase on PC version:
- Implement fractional upscaling, allows game to render at 1.25x, 1.5x (or 0.5x) the original resolution (Macdu)
- Add a FPS hack option which allows some games running at 30 FPS on the PS Vita to run at 60 fps on the emulator (Ys 8, GoW, Uncharted...) (Macdu)
- Language updates (Corden, nishinji)
- Multiple fixes (bookmist)
- Use hardware accelerated decryption: speed up game installation by almost 10x (Macdu)
- Improve depth/stencil identification: Fix shadows in Gravity Rush (Macdu)
- Use paths instead of wide strings for paths (bookmist)
- Improve path support on Linux (Steveice10)
- Put audio parameters in a new audio tab (Zangetsu)
- Add PS vita Audio/video folder access and crash fixes

releases.name: DOSBox Pure 1.0 Preview 6
releases.body:
This is the sixth preview release of version 1.0 of DOSBox Pure.

A smaller update with additions and fixes. Again, please test this release and provide feedback as we work towards a release we can call 1.0. Feedback is welcome here on GitHub as well as on [Discord](https://discord.gg/swhZC8xFJw).

## New Features

### Support for Dynamic VHD Disk Images (#694)
Installing an operating system will also automatically create dynamic VHD files from now on (which initially is just a few megabytes and grows as needed)

### Volume Settings (93cf48b)
Volume settings were added to the core options for the various DOS devices (Sound Blaster, Adlib, MIDI, etc.)]

### Handle shut down requests in Windows 9x (#738)
Minimal implementation of APM (Advanced Power Management) BIOS functionality just to handle the power off request by Windows 9x. This will allow to automatically go back to the menu or exit the core/emulator when the emulated Windows is shut down.

## Minor Additions
- Allow mounting of ZIP files via IMGMOUNT command (with `IMGMOUNT X: file.zip -t zip`) (04a1b95)
- Support a custom extended M3U format tag to overlay the multiple contents (i.e. load multiple ZIP files as C:) (#731)

GameNative for Mali handhelds, rebased on upstream GameNative 1.2.1.

**Proof of concept, released as is. No support:** I do not answer bug reports or questions, and I do not take requests for devices I do not own.

Download `gamenative-mali-modern.apk` below and install it. It installs next to the stock GameNative app (package `app.gamenative.mali`). It is debug-signed with this repository's fixed key, so it upgrades over earlier `mali` builds signed with the same key.

## What changed

- **Custom driver support for PanVK on Mali.** Import a Mesa PanVK package for your device in **Driver Manager**, then select it for a game under **Graphics**. No PanVK build is bundled, and the default stays the system driver.
- A Mali device no longer lists Turnip or Qualcomm drivers, and a container that names one falls back to the system driver.
- Rebased on upstream GameNative 1.2.1.

PanVK packages for the devices I own:
[Retroid Pocket 4 Pro](https://github.com/faux123/panvk-faux123-driver-rp4pro),
[Anbernic RG556](https://github.com/faux123/panvk-faux123-driver-rg556),
[GameForce Ace](https://github.com/faux123/panvk-faux123-driver-ace).

## Tested on

This exact APK is installed on my Game

releases.body:
# Pine Developer Diagnostics v1.3 — 开发预览

**这是诊断增强，不是 ART GC/堆损坏根因修复。** 复用已审查的 Debug APK，不重建、不重签；main 与旧预览 tag 不变。

源提交：`99115d70560c4872a094462bb179e0b772484d7f`；[草稿 PR #2](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/pull/2)。

本轮修复 trace 临时失败的有限重试与成功升级导出、轮转后完整关键字段、CNMT/Program/SaveOwner 身份分离、按 generation 清理与 Java 故障身份保留，以及原生身份回调的共享实例锁。DFX 只来自真实 guest 消息；不保证闭源 Lua 栈。

## 实际验证

- FullDebug 构建、101 项 JVM、native/core/content、Windows PS5.1/pwsh 假 ADB 与匹配符号通过。
- Diagnostics CI 执行 `testFullDebugUnitTest processFullReleaseMainManifest assembleFullDebug`；原 CI 执行 `assembleFulldebug`。Release manifest 处理通过，**不称 FullRelease APK 构建通过**。
- 官方 API35 x86_64 / `libndk_translation.so` 的 ARM64 APK 实际运行结果如下。属于翻译环境，不是物理 ARM64/NCE/商业游戏验收。

| 平台 | 实际报告 | 通过 | 阻塞 | 证据 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Linux | environment_blocked | 5 | 13 | [原始证据](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/actions/runs/39033021235/artifacts/12101598679) |
| Mac | verified | 18 | 0 | [原始证据](https://github.com/xmy953538104/pine_CN/actions/runs/39033021235/artifacts/12100794725) |

Mac 18/18 包含真实设置、默认关闭、开关/Session、原生 JSONL、PineDiag、等级/保留/类别、导出预览、私有快照、DocumentsUI SAF ZIP 逐字节匹配及 Stop。两个平台均观察到一次 System UI ANR，并记录一次普通 Wait 操作。Mac 随后完成18项；Linux

## Massive loading improvements and experimental Mali support

**Lumen Emu 0.1.6 brings a massive loading speedup in the tested PS5 startup path, restores direct local-ROM access for both PS4 and PS5, bundles Turnip Banners, and adds automatic experimental PanVK selection for compatible Mali GPUs.**

### Faster loading
